note: neiso-72 keeper recipe with NO INTENTIONAL CONFIG CHANGE -- NINE ScenarioConfig fields differ from the committed neiso72_hy_window_B keeper and ALL NINE are schema drift rather than a config change (CORRECTED 2026-08-03 by the calibration-keeper-auditor: the promotion note undercounted this at seven, omitting demand_growth_vintage and gas_offer_margin_anchor_by_zone -- verified by a full run_config.json scenario_config key diff, 671 keys this arm vs 662 incumbent): caiso_firm_import_selfsched_clip, coal_prb_committed_split, crossover_solve_year_weather, demand_growth_vintage, ercot_dam_availability_gas_event_cap, gas_offer_margin_anchor_by_zone, gas_offer_margin_zonal_anchor, miso_coal_night_floor and pjm_rggi_allowance_pricing were each ADDED to ScenarioConfig after the neiso-72 solve (git sha 10c624e; each field's introducing commit postdates it), seven default to False and two (demand_growth_vintage, gas_offer_margin_anchor_by_zone) default to None, and this arm records every one at its class default (the incumbent simply predates the field). The delta is the CONTENT of the shared measured CT heat-rate artifact the keeper already consumes: scripts/data/derive_campd_ct_heat_rates.py declares a physical band [6.0, 25.0] MMBtu/MWh but applied it ONLY to the plant aggregate, so individual loaded hours at physically impossible heat rates -- a meter artifact, not generation behaviour -- were averaged into the plant rate and diluted it LOW (the caiso-146 section 2.4 defect). The screen now applies the module's OWN declared band per loaded hour and evaluates the _MIN_LOADED_HOURS trust gate on the in-band hours. ZERO NEW PARAMETERS and ZERO ScenarioConfig surface: cap percentile, loaded fraction, all-hours gross_mwh weights, parasitic conversion, the plant-aggregate flag and the flag=='ok' application rule are untouched. THE ARTIFACT THIS KEEPER PINS: data/raw/_processed-legacy/campd_ct_heat_rates_NEISO.csv md5 293c6f6c52bef0570754c5182a04afc4, cap-weighted applied rate 9.8006 MMBtu/MWh net over 7/7 plants -- up from 9.6291 pre-fix (+0.1715), reproducing the pre-registered prediction (+0.171) to 4 dp, and the md5 matches the K1 arm-B pin recorded at solve time. LIVENESS, measured on this bundle against its own cold-solved same-HEAD control: P1 CT_PEAKER energy 0.3088 -> 0.2877 / 0.8433 -> 0.7566 / 1.7174 -> 1.6163 TWh for 2023/24/25 (-0.0211 / -0.0867 / -0.1011), up to 150.4 MW in a single class-hour and 2,566 of 8,760 hours changed in 2025. THE SCREEN IS LIVE AND SCORE-NEUTRAL, WHICH ARE DIFFERENT CLAIMS: it moves real energy in thousands of hours while flipping ZERO criteria and ZERO D-gates -- all six D-gate pass flags and every one of the 54 D-row verdicts are identical to the control's and to the incumbent keeper's. Load-weighted lambda moves +0.045 % / +0.055 % / +0.083 % of level, against a PRE-COMMITTED 1.0 pp escalation trigger, so no leave-one-year-out escalation is owed. THE CORRECTION IS NOT DRIVEN BY DROPS (K6): NEISO is the tightest of the six ISOs on this check because it drops one unit (63559), and recomputing the applied-map delta with the dropped unit RETAINED at its screened rate still gives +0.1319 -- a 23.1 % divergence against a pre-committed 25 % bar, same sign. The screen is meter hygiene, not selection. ZERO FREE PARAMETERS: the DOF ledger is the neiso-72 keeper's carried forward unchanged at 12 entries / 5 residual, asserted by the generator rather than assumed. Rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] governs the promotion in both directions; rule 23 [R-FROZEN-DERIVE] is satisfied because the re-derivation is driven by a meter defect in the derive, never by a residual. Rule 28b: measured_ct_heat_rates keeps its existing per-ISO cell verdicts -- an input correction with no mechanism surface.
